stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav seeks more seats for INDIA bloc in UP
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav has asked Congress to expand its list of winnable seats beyond the 26 currently under discussion. He urged the parties to contest the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections as a unified INDIA bloc. The negotiations are expected to continue.

stories.title: SP announces first five candidates for UP polls
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party has released its first list of five candidates for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. The announcement comes as the party continues seat-sharing discussions with Congress. The party has not yet confirmed the total number of seats it intends to contest.

stories.title: SP and Congress signal progress in seat-sharing talks
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav stated that seat-sharing discussions with Congress began with 26 seats and will move forward. The Samajwadi Party leader signaled a commitment to unity amid ongoing negotiations for the Uttar Pradesh assembly polls. The parties are working to finalize their electoral strategy.

stories.title: CJP convenor rules out election participation
stories.summary: Abhijeet Dipke, convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party, said the group will not contest or support any party in the Uttar Pradesh polls. Dipke expressed hope for youth-centric elections, adding that the world is currently discussing artificial intelligence and renewable energy instead of caste and religion.

stories.title: Bhagwant Mann criticizes BJP and SAD alliance
stories.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has labeled the revived alliance between the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal a thug pact. He claimed the partnership is intended only to protect the families and political interests of the involved leaders.

stories.title: Kapil Sibal warns against seat increase proposal
stories.summary: Rajya Sabha member Kapil Sibal cautioned the opposition against accepting a government proposal to increase state assembly seats by 50 percent. Sibal claimed the BJP is seeking 362 votes to pass a constitutional amendment on delimitation and warned that democracy would not survive the move.

stories.title: SP reports positive progress in Congress talks
stories.summary: Ram Gopal Yadav described seat-sharing negotiations with Congress as very positive. The Samajwadi Party leader stated that the parties expect to finalize their agreement within two meetings. The discussions aim to consolidate the opposition's position for the upcoming elections.

stories.title: Congress labels BJP-SAD alliance a necessity
stories.summary: Punjab Congress working president Raj Kumar Verka described the renewed BJP-SAD alliance as a political necessity rather than a choice. Verka asserted that voters view both parties as anti-Punjab and predicted the partnership would fail to achieve significant electoral gains.

stories.title: PM Modi welcomes BJP-SAD reunion
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the revived alliance between the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal as a natural partnership. Modi stated that the reunion will ensure pro-people governance in Punjab, six years after the Akali Dal withdrew from the National Democratic Alliance.

stories.title: BJP-SAD alliance returns to Punjab politics
stories.summary: The BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal have revived their partnership for the upcoming Punjab assembly elections. The alliance, which previously broke apart over farm laws, is now positioning itself to challenge existing political dynamics in the state ahead of the 2027 polls.

stories.title: Amit Shah confirms leadership structure for BJP-SAD alliance
stories.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that the Shiromani Akali Dal will provide the chief ministerial candidate for the newly revived alliance with the BJP. Shah referred to the Akali Dal as the elder brother in the partnership for the upcoming Punjab assembly elections.

stories.title: Kejriwal dismisses BJP-SAD alliance
stories.summary: Arvind Kejriwal criticized the revived BJP-SAD partnership ahead of the 2027 Punjab assembly elections. The Aam Aadmi Party national convenor stated that his party's alliance is with the people of Punjab rather than for the pursuit of power.

stories.title: Court denies bail to PG operator in building collapse
stories.summary: A Delhi court denied bail to Shubham Tyagi, an operator of the paying guest accommodation that collapsed in Satya Niketan, killing seven people. The court observed that Tyagi appeared to have prioritized financial gains over the safety of the students and laborers residing in the building.

stories.title: Website selling lifetime press cards faces scrutiny
stories.summary: A website called the Indian Press Union is selling lifetime press identity cards for 1,799 rupees. The platform has drawn criticism from media groups and Delhi Police, who questioned the organization's authority to issue credentials after encountering the cards during recent protests.

stories.title: Traffic restrictions announced for Shivaji Park rally
stories.summary: Mumbai Traffic Police announced restrictions in Dadar for the Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi rally on November 25. The event, led by Prakash Ambedkar, is expected to draw large crowds ahead of Constitution Day. Authorities anticipate significant congestion on major highways leading to the venue.

stories.title: CJP official stopped at Delhi airport
stories.summary: Saurav Das, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party, was prevented from boarding a flight to London on Monday. Officials stated the action followed his failure to respond to a show-cause notice from the Chennai Regional Passport Office regarding discrepancies in his identity documents.

stories.title: Parking curbs set for 26/11 memorial
stories.summary: Mumbai Traffic Police will enforce parking restrictions in south Mumbai on November 26 for the annual memorial commemorating the 26/11 terror attacks. The event, attended by the Maharashtra Governor, is scheduled to begin at 9 a.m. at the Police Commissioner's office.

stories.title: FIR filed against TVK MLA for alleged misconduct
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu police informed the Madras High Court that an FIR has been registered against Kallakurichi MLA C. Arul Vignesh. The legislator is accused of misbehaving with a woman IAS officer. The court ordered that the investigation be monitored by the Inspector-General of Police.

stories.title: Samajwadi Party reveals 5 candidates for Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party announced five candidates for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls. Party president Akhilesh Yadav urged Congress to engage in serious discussions to ensure alliance victory, describing the election as a historic opportunity to defeat the BJP and save the country from falling.

stories.title: 1,420 police personnel deployed for first phase panchayat polls in Palnadu
stories.summary: Palnadu police have deployed 1,420 personnel for the first phase of panchayat elections starting November 26. The deployment covers seven mandals and the Narasaraopet municipal elections. Security at election distribution centres and strong rooms has been reviewed to ensure voters exercise their franchise without fear.

stories.title: SP declares candidates for five seats in U.P. Assembly polls
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party announced five candidates for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls. Party president Akhilesh Yadav urged Congress to engage in serious discussions to ensure alliance victory, describing the election as a historic opportunity to defeat the BJP and save the country from falling.

stories.title: CORAL to SIGMA: Bengaluru’s five police commissioners get new wireless call signs
stories.summary: Bengaluru City Police has assigned new wireless call signs to its five police commissioners to facilitate coordination. The commissioners will now use the codes CORAL, ECHO, NOVA, WINDSOR and SIGMA. The Commissioner of Police for traffic will continue to use his existing call sign.

stories.title: No defence data breach, says Government, as security agencies asked to audit messaging groups
stories.summary: The Defence Ministry says there has been no leak of sensitive information. Officials stated that documents circulating on social media are fake and intended to create confusion. All formations have been directed to exercise caution while using messaging platforms. The confusion remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: Man who went on stabbing spree at Delhi police station probed for gang links
stories.summary: Police are investigating a 30-year-old man who allegedly stabbed nine officers at a Delhi police station for potential links to an organised gang. Investigators have not found social media accounts for the suspect and are examining whether he was influenced by specific reading material.

stories.title: Karnataka govt. welcomes Pixxel’s ₹350-crore satellite manufacturing facility
stories.summary: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar welcomed Pixxel’s plan to build a 250,000 sq. ft. satellite manufacturing facility in Karnataka with a ₹350 crore investment. The government described the project as a strong endorsement of the state's talent and capabilities in the growing space sector.

stories.title: DEFCORE 2026 to spotlight MSME component makers in Visakhapatnam
stories.summary: The first edition of DEFCORE 2026 will be held in Visakhapatnam from November 25 to 27. The event focuses on micro, small and medium enterprises that supply components to the defence and aerospace sector, aiming to integrate Indian manufacturers into domestic and global supply chains.

stories.title: APSSDC to organise overseas recruitment drive in Visakhapatnam
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation will hold an overseas recruitment drive in Visakhapatnam on November 25. The event offers roles in construction, hospitality, engineering and logistics for candidates aged 18 to 40. Requirements vary by company, and applicants are advised to bring updated documents.

stories.title: Hyundai India to raise prices on select models by up to ₹8,000 from December 1
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India will increase prices on select models by up to 8,000 rupees from December 1. The company cited a sharp increase in input costs, particularly for steel and copper, as the reason for the hike. Maruti Suzuki recently announced similar price adjustments.

stories.title: SpiceJet’s flight cuts put spotlight on global 80/20 rule for airport slots
stories.summary: SpiceJet's recent flight reductions have highlighted the global 80/20 rule for airport slots. Under civil aviation guidelines, an airport slot represents permission from a coordinator to use the full range of airport infrastructure. The rule requires airlines to use their allocated slots or risk losing them.

stories.title: Coca-Cola plans Gold Spot comeback after 26 years
stories.summary: Coca-Cola is planning to reintroduce the orange-flavoured drink Gold Spot to the Indian market after a 26-year absence. Reports suggest the company may also launch a low-sugar variant as it attempts to make the legacy brand relevant to modern consumer preferences and competition.

stories.title: IAF may get its first India-made C295 transport aircraft by Dec 31
stories.summary: The Indian Air Force expects to receive its first locally manufactured C295 transport aircraft by December 31. The aircraft is currently undergoing final flight trials and certification. It will be the first military aircraft built by India’s private industry, specifically Tata Advanced Systems Limited and Airbus.

stories.title: First lot of delayed light combat aircraft by March, HAL tells Indian Air Force
stories.summary: The Indian Air Force has agreed to accept a squadron of delayed Tejas LCA Mk-1A fighters by March 31, 2027. State-run manufacturer Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd has committed to delivering 16 to 18 jets by that date. The timeline was confirmed during recent discussions between the two parties.

stories.title: Cottage and micro industries await relief from GST notices for arrears
stories.summary: Micro and cottage industries in Coimbatore are seeking relief from GST penalty and interest notices issued by the Commercial Taxes Department. The arrears were previously waived under amnesty schemes. Associations plan to meet the state minister to address the ongoing confusion regarding the tax notices.

stories.title: NBFCs tap AI to spot defaults early, lower credit costs
stories.summary: L&T Finance reported a decline in EMI bounce rates after implementing its AI-powered underwriting platform, Cyclops. The company noted that bounce rates in its SME portfolio are now half of those in its legacy portfolio, while quarterly disbursements have increased following the platform's adoption.

stories.title: Unity Group seals Rs 1,750 crore Mohali land deal
stories.summary: Unity Group has acquired land in Mohali for Rs 1,750 crore to develop a mixed-use project featuring branded residences, hotels, hospitals and retail space. The company stated that the project aims to change the landscape of the city, mirroring its previous developments in Delhi.

stories.title: Coca Cola plans a fanta-stic move to hit the Gold Spot in fight with Reliance
stories.summary: Coca-Cola is bringing back the orange-flavoured drink Gold Spot after 26 years. The company is attempting to leverage nostalgia to compete with rivals like Reliance. The market has changed significantly since the brand was last available, and the company is adjusting its strategy accordingly.

stories.title: SHRC directs NHAI and KSEB to install lights on Container Road
stories.summary: The Kerala State Human Rights Commission has ordered the National Highways Authority of India to install streetlights on the 17-km Container Road. The KSEB must provide power within two weeks. The directive follows a complaint noting that many NHAI-maintained corridors currently lack lighting.

stories.title: HMDA to use treated Coca-Cola wastewater for ORR greenery
stories.summary: The Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority has partnered with Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages to reuse treated water for Outer Ring Road landscaping. The company will supply 600 kilolitres daily from its facility. The water undergoes multi-stage treatment and continuous monitoring to ensure it remains suitable for non-potable applications.

stories.title: BRO defends earthmover use at Sheshnag lake
stories.summary: The Border Roads Organisation says it is widening tracks at the high-altitude Sheshnag lake to ensure pilgrim safety for the Amarnath Yatra. The agency claims it took measures to minimise terrain disturbance. The statement follows public outcry and viral footage of construction activity in the glacial zone.

stories.title: Over 20 houses damaged in Uttarkashi fire
stories.summary: A fire in Mori tehsil destroyed over 20 houses in Pawani village on Tuesday. The district administration deployed rescue teams after receiving reports of the blaze at 4.49pm. Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami has directed officials to expedite relief operations for the affected residents.

stories.title: Supreme Court seeks expert opinion on Kuno safari proposals
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has asked the Central Empowered Committee to review Madhya Pradesh government proposals for a cheetah safari at Kuno and a zoo-cum-safari at Naulakhi forest. The court previously approved a night safari in Uttar Pradesh four months ago. This marks the first step toward expansion.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu deploys officers to monitor drought risks
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu has deployed 19 senior agriculture officials as district monitoring officers to assist farmers amid inadequate rainfall. The agriculture department cited the El Nino phenomenon and an erratic Northeast monsoon as reasons for the move. The officials will coordinate field-level responses across state departments.

He joined Hindustan Times in 2021 after beginning his journalism career at The Times

stories.summary: Jasjeev Gandhiok is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times, where he covers environment, climate change, the clean energy transition and wildlife at the National Bureau. Gandhiok has over a decade of experience in journalism and is based in Delhi. He has reported extensively on Delhi and the National Capital Region

stories.summary: NEW DELHI: A video showing a JCB operating near Sheshnag Lake along the Amarnath Yatra route in Jammu and Kashmir has triggered a political row, with leaders and environmentalists questioning the construction activity in the fragile glacial zone.The controversy has intensified after political leaders raised concerns over the environmental impact

stories.title: Street plays to promote co-existence between humans and wildlife organised in Kotagiri
stories.summary: Street plays to promote peaceful co-existence between humans and wildlife were organised in Kotagiri and Kattabettu forest ranges in the Nilgiris forest divisions recently. The street plays were organised by Keystone Foundation in collaboration with the Forest Department. The two-day human-wildlife interaction awareness programme included street plays performed by Aayudham

stories.summary: Aveek Banerjee is a Senior Content Producer at the Hindustan Times, based in Greater Noida West. With more than five years of experience in digital journalism, Aveek has worked extensively in covering national politics and international affairs, including elections, high-profile diplomatic engagements and geopolitical conflicts. stories.title: EU calls for regional cooperation with India to secure Indian Ocean sea lanes
stories.summary: Rezaul Hasan Laskar is Foreign Editor with the Hindustan Times, which he joined in 2015. He began as a journalist in his hometown of Shillong in northeast India and has worked in newspapers and wire services over the years. He moved to New Delhi in 1997 and initially focused on

stories.title: Kuki and Naga leaders call for Christmas truce
stories.summary: Leaders from Kuki and Naga communities held a three-day summit in Kolkata to discuss ethnic violence in Manipur. The Forum for Naga Reconciliation facilitated the dialogue and urged both groups to observe a Christmas truce. The summit was described as a confidence-building measure.

I am skilled in breaking news, leading editorial teams and launch of newspaper editions. I am adept at leveraging digital

stories.title: Earthquake in Nepal felt across North Bengal and Sikkim
stories.summary: A 5.3 magnitude earthquake in Nepal caused tremors across North Bengal and Sikkim on Tuesday morning. The National Centre for Seismology confirmed the event, which was also reported in several districts of Bihar. There were no immediate reports of major damage from the affected regions.

stories.title: PM Modi, German Chancellor Merz Discuss Global Peace, Strategic Ties On Call
stories.summary: PM Modi and Chancellor Merz agreed to continue working closely.

stories.title: NSA Ajit Doval meets Maldives defence minister in Colombo
stories.summary: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval met Maldives defence minister Hassan Rasheed during the Colombo Security Conclave to discuss security cooperation. This marks the first high-level contact between the nations since the Maldives signed 20 memorandums of understanding with Pakistan during a recent state visit.

stories.title: PM Modi, Merz say India-EU FTA will unlock new opportunities
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz discussed the India-Germany Strategic Partnership and the potential for an India-EU free trade agreement. The leaders noted that the agreement would unlock several new opportunities for expanding bilateral trade and investment. The talks preceded further diplomatic engagements.

stories.title: Indians among 13 killed in UAE bus-truck crash
stories.summary: Thirteen people died and 14 were injured after a bus carrying 41 passengers collided with a truck parked on a roadside in Ras Al Khaimah. The Indian consulate in Dubai confirmed Indian nationals were among the deceased. The truck had reportedly stopped following a technical breakdown.

stories.title: China delays rare earths export ban
stories.summary: China's Commerce Ministry extended the suspension of export prohibitions on gallium, germanium and antimony through January 27. The materials are essential for semiconductors and military equipment. The decision maintains a trade truce following the recent summit between President Xi Jinping and Donald Trump in Shenzhen.

stories.title: EU holds maritime security meeting in Delhi
stories.summary: The European Union hosted its first high-level maritime security exchange in New Delhi, supported by the ESIWA+ project. The EU stated it is committed to strengthening security cooperation in the Indo-Pacific region, identifying maritime security as a shared priority with the Indian Ocean Rim Association.

stories.title: Google denies mass India layoffs
stories.summary: Google rejected reports of large-scale staff reductions in India, stating that 30 roles were eliminated. The company maintains that these adjustments are part of standard operational changes rather than a broader restructuring effort.

stories.title: Professor warns of AI control loss
stories.summary: Stuart Russell stated that humans risk ceding control to artificial intelligence, potentially weakening cognitive abilities. The professor suggests that as reliance on machines grows, the capacity for human oversight may diminish.

stories.title: Jensen Huang discloses additional affairs to Nvidia board
stories.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang disclosed additional extramarital affairs to his board of directors during a meeting regarding his conduct and transparency. The disclosures followed reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, who has been linked to Chinese intelligence. The board subsequently voted to reinstate him.

stories.title: Nvidia navigates US-China chip restrictions
stories.summary: Washington has tightened restrictions on China's access to advanced American chips, even as Chinese investors welcomed the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. State-backed media in China have renewed calls for technological self-reliance in response to the ongoing supply constraints.

stories.title: Nasdaq and S&P 500 decline as investors weigh Nvidia leadership
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.48% and the Nasdaq dropped 1.45% as markets assessed the implications of Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO. While his reinstatement initially triggered a rally, investors are now weighing the governance and political risks surrounding his leadership.

stories.title: HPE shares drop despite earnings beat
stories.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise shares fell 16% after the company raised its 2027 revenue growth forecast to 35%. Analysts flagged potential margin compression and a slowdown in the second half of the fiscal year, tempering the market's reaction to the fourth-quarter earnings beat.

stories.title: Firefighters contain five-alarm blaze in Union, New Jersey
stories.summary: A five-alarm fire destroyed several businesses in downtown Union, New Jersey, after breaking out early Tuesday morning. Approximately 90 firefighters responded to the scene, where a partial roof collapse occurred. No injuries were reported among civilians or emergency personnel.

stories.title: China and India increase Russian oil imports
stories.summary: Seaborne Russian oil shipments to China and India averaged 3.4 million barrels per day through mid-November, an increase of 530,000 barrels per day from last year. Analysts expect demand to wane in 2027 as Middle Eastern supplies reclaim market share.

stories.title: Oil prices fall despite shipping corridor risks
stories.summary: Oil prices dropped below $90 despite threats to critical shipping corridors in the Strait of Hormuz. Markets are currently prioritizing expectations of abundant global supply over the risk of conflict. The decline provides unexpected relief for Indian refiners and policymakers.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA cancels Inducare manufacturing licences
stories.summary: The Maharashtra FDA cancelled the manufacturing licences of Inducare Pharmaceutical for the second time. The firm was found selling nine drugs without permission, which were later declared spurious or substandard. The company has been ordered to cease all operations and faces proposed prosecution.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA warns against unlicensed supplement sales
stories.summary: FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe warned of strict action against gym operators selling health supplements without authorization. The state-wide order targets misleading health claims and the unregulated sale of nutraceuticals, following concerns over the marketing and consumption of whey protein products.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh extends health scheme to retired staff
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government extended its Employees Health Scheme to transport staff who retired on or after January 1, 2020. Eligible retirees and their spouses may enroll by paying a one-time subscription fee. Over 10,000 employees are covered by the policy change.

stories.title: Neurosurgeon highlights non-invasive treatment options
stories.summary: Dr. Mohana Rao Patibandla advocated for non-invasive neurosurgery, citing the successful use of stereotactic radiosurgery to treat trigeminal neuralgia. The procedure allowed a patient to avoid the risks associated with conventional surgery. Modern neurosurgery is increasingly focused on identifying safer, individualised treatment options.

stories.title: Family alleges negligence in Kanhangad hospital death
stories.summary: A 70-year-old woman died at Kanhangad District Hospital following hernia surgery. Her family filed a complaint alleging medical negligence, leading police to register a case of unnatural death. The body has been transferred to Kannur Government Medical College Hospital for a post-mortem examination.

stories.title: Three workers die in Hyderabad septic tank accident
stories.summary: Three sanitation workers died of suffocation while cleaning a septic tank at a residential apartment complex in Bachupally. The victims were employed by a private cleaning agency. Police have launched an investigation into the incident at the Dinesh Auric Apartments.

stories.title: ED arrests fake doctor in CSR donation scam
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate arrested Dharmendra Kumar Chandradev Singh for allegedly running a 200 crore rupee bogus CSR donation racket. Despite having only a Class XII education, Singh reportedly represented himself as a doctor to manage a network of charitable trusts. The investigation into the money laundering continues.

stories.title: Keralam to ban unapproved cosmetics
stories.summary: Health Minister K Muraleedharan announced that Keralam will prohibit the sale of any cosmetic product lacking government approval. The state plans to take stringent action against sellers of fake cosmetics. The minister advised the public to avoid experimenting with creams that do not carry official clearance.

stories.title: Goa FDA increases water brand surveillance
stories.summary: Goa's Food and Drugs Administration has intensified surveillance of packaged drinking water following a controversy involving an unsafe Bisleri sample. Officials confirmed the specific batch is no longer available and a prosecution case has been filed. The FDA is now testing various other brands sold in the state.

stories.title: Bisleri says Goa batch was isolated incident
stories.summary: Bisleri stated that all 143 of its manufacturing plants remain operational following recent regulatory scrutiny. The company maintains that the issue was limited to a single batch in Goa which is now out of circulation.

stories.title: ICMR survey finds widespread nutritional deficiencies
stories.summary: A national survey by the ICMR found that over 50 percent of women of reproductive age are anaemic, while nearly two-thirds of adolescents are deficient in vitamin B12. The study analysed blood samples from over 1.7 lakh people, highlighting a nutritional challenge that extends beyond iron deficiency.

stories.title: Keralam introduces mandatory cosmetic retail licenses
stories.summary: Keralam has begun requiring a mandatory license and registration for the sale of all cosmetics. While the government cracks down on spurious products, regulatory officials suggest that consumer awareness regarding label information remains more effective than enforcement alone. The state is now tightening its oversight of retail and wholesale.

stories.title: IIT Madras opens autism and sleep research facilities
stories.summary: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava inaugurated an autism laboratory and a sleep research facility at IIT Madras on Sunday. The sleep study centre aims to provide individuals with access to specialised assessment and treatment through experts from Kauvery Hospitals. An e-ambulance service was also launched.

stories.title: Sustainability experts visit Chengalpattu eco-farm
stories.summary: Experts from IIT-Madras and the University of Birmingham visited a Chengalpattu eco-farm to study community sustainability models. The group observed methods including rainwater harvesting, solar energy use, and the cultivation of medicinal herbs. The institution is currently exploring ways to scale these local practices.

stories.title: Textiles Minister calls for global silk standards
stories.summary: Union Minister Giriraj Singh urged the establishment of international standards for silk authenticity and traceability to protect the industry from artificial alternatives. Speaking at the International Sericultural Commission congress, he noted that climate change and sustainability are significant challenges for the global sector.

stories.title: Small-town kindness meets digital tools
Teen's complaint triggers Keralam cosmetic crackdown
stories.summary: A disclosure by a teenager regarding a spurious fairness cream has prompted the Keralam government to order statewide inspections of beauty parlours and cosmetic centres. Dermatologists are warning the public against unauthorised products that promise instant results. The government has promised further action against the sale of such items.

stories.title: Why Sale Of Zubeen Garg's Range Rover Has Become Matter Of Public Debate
Supporters launch political forum for actor Trisha
stories.summary: Supporters of actor Trisha Krishnan have launched a political organisation in Tirunelveli titled the Revolutionary Leader Trisha Forum. The group unveiled an emblem featuring the actor and a slogan focused on public rights. Organisers stated the forum is a first step toward placing the actor in politics.

stories.title: Parliamentary session remains unprorogued after 100 days
stories.summary: The 2026 Monsoon Session of Parliament has not been formally terminated after 100 days of adjournment sine die. Congress leader Jairam Ramesh noted the record duration. Under current rules, the Speaker can reconvene the house without a new presidential summons or the standard two-week notice period.

stories.title: Legal and ideological tensions rise in Thirupparankundram
stories.summary: Thirupparankundram, a town known for its syncretic religious sites, is facing a series of legal battles and ideological disputes. The area houses the Subramaniya Swamy Temple, the Kasi Viswanathar Temple, and the Sikandar Badusha Dargah. The site is now experiencing increased public and legal scrutiny.
